_README: C1.3's pre-decided G2 branch thresholds, as DATA rather than as literals in a page. FE-6/FE-11 read this file; E9's grep forbids a numeric literal in the calibration page source, and it is right to -- a threshold typed into JSX is a second copy of a plan decision that can drift from the plan silently. These are GATE CONSTANTS, not measurements: nothing here was measured, and nothing here may be changed to make a measurement pass.
